text: A pleasing land of drowsy head it was, Of dreams that wave before the half-shut eye; And of gay castles in the clouds that pass, Forever flushing round a summer sky.
zh: 这是一片令人昏昏欲睡的宜人之地，梦想在半闭的眼睛前摇曳；还有飘过的云彩中的欢乐城堡，永远冲刷着夏日的天空。
chunks: A pleasing land of drowsy head it was,
Of dreams that wave before the half-shut eye;
And of gay castles
in the clouds that pass,
Forever flushing round a summer sky.

text: This name was given, we are told, in former days, by the good housewives of the adjacent country, from the inveterate propensity of their husbands to linger about the village tavern on market days.
zh: 据我们所知，这个名字是以前邻国的好家庭主妇们起的，因为她们的丈夫在集市的日子里总是喜欢在村里的小酒馆里流连。
chunks: This name was given,
we are told, in former days,
by the good housewives of the adjacent country,
from the inveterate propensity of their husbands to linger
about the village tavern on market days.

text: Be that as it may, I do not vouch for the fact, but merely advert to it, for the sake of being precise and authentic.
chunks: Be that as it may,
I do not vouch for the fact,
but merely advert to it,
for the sake
of being precise and authentic.

text: Not far from this village, perhaps about two miles, there is a little valley or rather lap of land among high hills, which is one of the quietest places in the whole world.
zh: 离这个村庄不远，大概两英里左右，有一个小山谷，或者更确切地说是高山之间的一片土地，这是全世界最安静的地方之一。
chunks: Not far from this village, perhaps about two miles,
there is a little valley
or rather lap of land
among high hills, which is one
of the quietest places in the whole world.

text: A small brook glides through it, with just murmur enough to lull one to repose; and the occasional whistle of a quail or tapping of a woodpecker is almost the only sound that ever breaks in upon the uniform tranquillity.
zh: 一条小溪从其中流过，潺潺流水声足以使人平静下来。鹌鹑偶尔发出的哨声或啄木鸟的敲击声几乎是唯一打破这片宁静的声音。
chunks: A small brook glides through it,
with just murmur enough to lull one to repose;
and the occasional whistle of a quail or tapping
of a woodpecker is almost the only sound
that ever breaks in upon the uniform tranquillity.

text: I recollect that, when a stripling, my first exploit in squirrel-shooting was in a grove of tall walnut-trees that shades one side of the valley.
zh: 我记得，当我还是个小伙子时，我第一次射击松鼠是在山谷一侧遮荫的高大核桃树林里。
chunks: I recollect that, when a stripling,
my first exploit in squirrel-shooting was
in a grove of tall walnut-trees
that shades one side
of the valley.

text: I had wandered into it at noontime, when all nature is peculiarly quiet, and was startled by the roar of my own gun, as it broke the Sabbath stillness around and was prolonged and reverberated by the angry echoes.
zh: 我是在正午时分走进这里的，当时整个大自然都特别安静，我被自己枪的轰鸣声吓了一跳，因为它打破了周围安息日的寂静，并被愤怒的回声延长并回响。
chunks: I had wandered into it at noontime,
when all nature is peculiarly quiet,
and was startled by the roar of my own gun,
as it broke the Sabbath stillness
around and was prolonged and reverberated by the angry echoes.

text: If ever I should wish for a retreat whither I might steal from the world and its distractions, and dream quietly away the remnant of a troubled life, I know of none more promising than this little valley.
zh: 如果我希望有一个隐居处，可以逃离这个世界和它的干扰，安静地梦想着摆脱烦恼生活的残余，我知道没有比这个小山谷更有希望的了。
chunks: If ever I should wish for a retreat whither I might steal
from the world and its distractions,
and dream quietly away the remnant
of a troubled life, I know
of none more promising than this little valley.

text: From the listless repose of the place, and the peculiar character of its inhabitants, who are descendants from the original Dutch settlers, this sequestered glen has long been known by the name of SLEEPY HOLLOW, and its rustic lads are called the Sleepy Hollow Boys throughout all the neighboring country.
chunks: From the listless repose of the place,
and the peculiar character of its inhabitants, who are descendants
from the original Dutch settlers, this sequestered glen has long been known
by the name of SLEEPY HOLLOW,
and its rustic lads are called the Sleepy Hollow Boys throughout all the neighboring country.

text: A drowsy, dreamy influence seems to hang over the land, and to pervade the very atmosphere.
zh: 一种昏昏欲睡、梦幻般的影响似乎笼罩着大地，弥漫在空气中。
chunks: A drowsy,
dreamy influence seems
to hang
over the land,
and to pervade the very atmosphere.

text: Certain it is, the place still continues under the sway of some witching power, that holds a spell over the minds of the good people, causing them to walk in a continual reverie.
zh: 可以肯定的是，这个地方仍然在某种巫术力量的影响下继续存在，它对善良人们的心灵施了咒语，使他们行走在不断的遐想中。
chunks: Certain it is, the place still continues
under the sway of some witching power,
that holds a spell over the minds
of the good people, causing them to walk
in a continual reverie.

text: They are given to all kinds of marvellous beliefs, are subject to trances and visions, and frequently see strange sights, and hear music and voices in the air.
zh: 他们有各种奇妙的信仰，容易出现恍惚和异象，经常看到奇怪的景象，听到空气中的音乐和声音。
chunks: They are given to all kinds
of marvellous beliefs,
are subject to trances and visions,
and frequently see strange sights,
and hear music and voices in the air.

text: The whole neighborhood abounds with local tales, haunted spots, and twilight superstitions; stars shoot and meteors glare oftener across the valley than in any other part of the country, and the nightmare, with her whole ninefold, seems to make it the favorite scene of her gambols.
chunks: The whole neighborhood abounds with local tales, haunted spots,
and twilight superstitions; stars shoot and meteors glare oftener across the valley
than in any other part
of the country, and the nightmare, with her whole ninefold,
seems to make it the favorite scene of her gambols.

text: The dominant spirit, however, that haunts this enchanted region, and seems to be commander-in-chief of all the powers of the air, is the apparition of a figure on horseback, without a head.
zh: 然而，在这片迷人的地区出没的主宰灵魂，似乎是所有空中力量的总司令，是一个骑在马背上的无头人物的幽灵。
chunks: The dominant spirit, however, that haunts this enchanted region,
and seems to be commander-in-chief
of all the powers
of the air, is the apparition
of a figure on horseback, without a head.

text: It is said by some to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper, whose head had been carried away by a cannon-ball, in some nameless battle during the Revolutionary War, and who is ever and anon seen by the country folk hurrying along in the gloom of night, as if on the wings of the wind.
chunks: It is said by some to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper,
whose head had been carried away
by a cannon-ball, in some nameless battle during the Revolutionary War,
and who is ever and anon seen by the country folk hurrying along
in the gloom of night, as if on the wings of the wind.

text: His haunts are not confined to the valley, but extend at times to the adjacent roads, and especially to the vicinity of a church at no great distance.
zh: 他经常出没的地方并不局限于山谷，有时还会延伸到邻近的道路，尤其是不远处的一座教堂附近。
chunks: His haunts are not confined
to the valley, but extend at times
to the adjacent roads,
and especially to the vicinity
of a church at no great distance.

text: Headless Horseman of Sleepy Hollow.
zh: 断头谷的无头骑士。
chunks: Headless Horseman
of Sleepy Hollow.

text: It is remarkable that the visionary propensity I have mentioned is not confined to the native inhabitants of the valley, but is unconsciously imbibed by every one who resides there for a time.
zh: 值得注意的是，我提到的这种幻想倾向并不局限于山谷里的本地居民，而是每一个在那里居住过一段时间的人都在不知不觉中被吸收了。
chunks: It is remarkable
that the visionary propensity I have mentioned is not confined
to the native inhabitants of the valley,
but is unconsciously imbibed
by every one who resides there for a time.

text: However wide awake they may have been before they entered that sleepy region, they are sure, in a little time, to inhale the witching influence of the air, and begin to grow imaginative, to dream dreams, and see apparitions.
zh: 无论他们在进入那个昏昏欲睡的区域之前多么清醒，他们肯定会在短时间内吸入空气中的巫术影响，并开始变得富有想象力，做梦，看到幻影。
chunks: However wide awake they may have been
before they entered that sleepy region,
they are sure, in a little time,
to inhale the witching influence of the air, and begin
to grow imaginative, to dream dreams, and see apparitions.

text: They are like those little nooks of still water, which border a rapid stream, where we may see the straw and bubble riding quietly at anchor, or slowly revolving in their mimic harbor, undisturbed by the rush of the passing current.
zh: 它们就像那些紧邻急流的静水小角落，我们可以看到稻草和泡沫静静地停泊在锚泊处，或者在它们的模拟港口中缓慢旋转，不受流过的水流的干扰。
chunks: They are like those little nooks
of still water, which border a rapid stream,
where we may see the straw
and bubble riding quietly at anchor, or slowly revolving
in their mimic harbor, undisturbed by the rush of the passing current.

text: I question whether I should not still find the same trees and the same families vegetating in its sheltered bosom.
zh: 我想知道我是否仍然会发现同样的树木和同样的家庭在它庇护的怀抱中生长。
chunks: I question whether I should not still find the same trees
and the same families vegetating
in its sheltered bosom.

text: In this by-place of nature there abode, in a remote period of American history, that is to say, some thirty years since, a worthy wight of the name of Ichabod Crane, who sojourned, or, as he expressed it, “tarried,” in Sleepy Hollow, for the purpose of instructing the children of the vicinity.
chunks: In this by-place of nature there abode, in a remote period of American history,
that is to say, some thirty years since, a worthy wight of the name
of Ichabod Crane, who sojourned, or, as he expressed it, “tarried,
” in Sleepy Hollow, for the purpose
of instructing the children of the vicinity.

text: Union with pioneers for the mind as well as for the forest, and sends forth yearly its legions of frontier woodmen and country schoolmasters.
chunks: Union with pioneers
for the mind as well
as for the forest,
and sends forth yearly its legions
of frontier woodmen and country schoolmasters.

text: The cognomen of Crane was not inapplicable to his person.
zh: 克莱恩这个名字对于他本人来说并非不适用。
chunks: The cognomen
of Crane was not inapplicable to his person.

text: He was tall, but exceedingly lank, with narrow shoulders, long arms and legs, hands that dangled a mile out of his sleeves, feet that might have served for shovels, and his whole frame most loosely hung together.
zh: 他很高，但非常瘦长，肩膀狭窄，胳膊和腿很长，手从袖子里垂下来一英里，脚可能用来拿铲子，他的整个身体松散地挂在一起。
chunks: He was tall, but exceedingly lank,
with narrow shoulders, long arms and legs,
hands that dangled a mile out of his sleeves,
feet that might have served for shovels,
and his whole frame most loosely hung together.

text: His head was small, and flat at top, with huge ears, large green glassy eyes, and a long snipe nose, so that it looked like a weather-cock perched upon his spindle neck to tell which way the wind blew.
zh: 他的头很小，顶部平坦，有一双巨大的耳朵，一双玻璃般的绿色大眼睛，还有一个长长的鹬鼻子，看起来就像一只风标停在他的纺锤状脖子上，告诉风向。
chunks: His head was small, and flat at top, with huge ears,
large green glassy eyes, and a long snipe nose,
so that it looked like a weather-cock perched
upon his spindle neck to tell
which way the wind blew.

text: To see him striding along the profile of a hill on a windy day, with his clothes bagging and fluttering about him, one might have mistaken him for the genius of famine descending upon the earth, or some scarecrow eloped from a cornfield.
zh: 刮风的日子里，他大步走在山坡上，衣服鼓鼓的，在身上飘扬，人们可能会误认为他是降临大地的饥荒天才，或者是从玉米地里逃出来的稻草人。
chunks: To see him striding along the profile
of a hill on a windy day,
with his clothes bagging and fluttering about him,
one might have mistaken him for the genius of famine descending
upon the earth, or some scarecrow eloped from a cornfield.

text: His schoolhouse was a low building of one large room, rudely constructed of logs; the windows partly glazed, and partly patched with leaves of old copybooks.
zh: 他的校舍是一栋低矮的建筑，只有一个大房间，用原木建造得简陋。窗户部分是玻璃的，部分是用旧习字簿的叶子修补的。
chunks: His schoolhouse was a low building
of one large room, rudely constructed of logs;
the windows partly glazed,
and partly patched with leaves
of old copybooks.

text: The schoolhouse stood in a rather lonely but pleasant situation, just at the foot of a woody hill, with a brook running close by, and a formidable birch-tree growing at one end of it.
zh: 校舍坐落在一座树木繁茂的山脚下，环境相当偏僻，但环境宜人，附近有一条小溪流过，小溪的一端长着一棵参天大树。
chunks: The schoolhouse stood in a rather lonely
but pleasant situation, just at the foot
of a woody hill, with a brook running close by,
and a formidable birch-tree growing
at one end of it.

text: Spare the rod and spoil the child.
zh: 省掉棍子，宠坏孩子。
chunks: Spare the rod
and spoil the child.

text: Ichabod Crane’s scholars certainly were not spoiled.
chunks: Ichabod Crane’s scholars certainly
were not spoiled.

text: I would not have it imagined, however, that he was one of those cruel potentates of the school who joy in the smart of their subjects; on the contrary, he administered justice with discrimination rather than severity; taking the burden off the backs of the weak, and laying it on those of the strong.
chunks: I would not have it imagined, however, that he was one of those cruel potentates
of the school who joy in the smart of their subjects;
on the contrary, he administered justice with discrimination rather than severity;
taking the burden off the backs
of the weak, and laying it on those of the strong.

text: Your mere puny stripling, that winced at the least flourish of the rod, was passed by with indulgence; but the claims of justice were satisfied by inflicting a double portion on some little tough wrong-headed, broad-skirted Dutch urchin, who sulked and swelled and grew dogged and sullen beneath the birch.
chunks: Your mere puny stripling, that winced at the least flourish of the rod, was passed
by with indulgence; but the claims
of justice were satisfied by inflicting a double portion
on some little tough wrong-headed, broad-skirted Dutch urchin, who sulked and swelled
and grew dogged and sullen beneath the birch.

text: All this he called “doing his duty by their parents;” and he never inflicted a chastisement without following it by the assurance, so consolatory to the smarting urchin, that “he would remember it and thank him for it the longest day he had to live.
chunks: All this he called “doing his duty by their parents;
” and he never inflicted a chastisement
without following it by the assurance, so consolatory to the smarting urchin,
that “he would remember it and thank him
for it the longest day he had to live.

text: When school hours were over, he was even the companion and playmate of the larger boys; and on holiday afternoons would convoy some of the smaller ones home, who happened to have pretty sisters, or good housewives for mothers, noted for the comforts of the cupboard.
chunks: When school hours were over, he was even the companion
and playmate of the larger boys;
and on holiday afternoons would convoy some
of the smaller ones home, who happened to have pretty sisters,
or good housewives for mothers, noted for the comforts of the cupboard.

text: Indeed, it behooved him to keep on good terms with his pupils.
zh: 事实上，他应该与学生保持良好的关系。
chunks: Indeed,
it behooved him
to keep
on good terms
with his pupils.

text: With these he lived successively a week at a time, thus going the rounds of the neighborhood, with all his worldly effects tied up in a cotton handkerchief.
zh: 他带着这些东西连续住了一个星期，就这样在附近走来走去，他所有的世俗物品都绑在一块棉手帕里。
chunks: With these he lived successively a week
at a time, thus going the rounds
of the neighborhood,
with all his worldly effects tied up
in a cotton handkerchief.

text: That all this might not be too onerous on the purses of his rustic patrons, who are apt to consider the costs of schooling a grievous burden, and schoolmasters as mere drones, he had various ways of rendering himself both useful and agreeable.
chunks: That all this might not be too onerous
on the purses of his rustic patrons,
who are apt to consider the costs of schooling a grievous burden,
and schoolmasters as mere drones, he had various ways
of rendering himself both useful and agreeable.

text: He assisted the farmers occasionally in the lighter labors of their farms, helped to make hay, mended the fences, took the horses to water, drove the cows from pasture, and cut wood for the winter fire.
zh: 他偶尔会帮助农民做一些农场里较轻松的劳动，帮助制作干草、修补栅栏、牵马去喝水、把牛赶出牧场、砍柴生火。
chunks: He assisted the farmers occasionally
in the lighter labors of their farms,
helped to make hay, mended the fences,
took the horses to water, drove the cows from pasture,
and cut wood for the winter fire.

text: He laid aside, too, all the dominant dignity and absolute sway with which he lorded it in his little empire, the school, and became wonderfully gentle and ingratiating.
zh: 他也抛开了他在他的小帝国——学校中的统治地位和绝对影响力——变得异常温柔和讨好。
chunks: He laid aside, too,
all the dominant dignity and absolute sway
with which he lorded it
in his little empire, the school,
and became wonderfully gentle and ingratiating.

text: He found favor in the eyes of the mothers by petting the children, particularly the youngest; and like the lion bold, which whilom so magnanimously the lamb did hold, he would sit with a child on one knee, and rock a cradle with his foot for whole hours together.
chunks: He found favor in the eyes
of the mothers by petting the children, particularly the youngest;
and like the lion bold, which whilom
so magnanimously the lamb did hold, he would sit with a child
on one knee, and rock a cradle with his foot for whole hours together.

text: In addition to his other vocations, he was the singing-master of the neighborhood, and picked up many bright shillings by instructing the young folks in psalmody.
zh: 除了他的其他职业之外，他还是附近的歌唱大师，并通过指导年轻人唱诗篇而赚到了许多光鲜亮丽的先令。
chunks: In addition to his other vocations,
he was the singing-master of the neighborhood,
and picked up many bright shillings
by instructing the young folks
in psalmody.

text: Sundays, to take his station in front of the church gallery, with a band of chosen singers; where, in his own mind, he completely carried away the palm from the parson.
chunks: Sundays, to take his station
in front of the church gallery,
with a band of chosen singers; where,
in his own mind,
he completely carried away the palm from the parson.

text: Thus, by divers little makeshifts, in that ingenious way which is commonly denominated “by hook and by crook,” the worthy pedagogue got on tolerably enough, and was thought, by all who understood nothing of the labor of headwork, to have a wonderfully easy life of it.
chunks: Thus, by divers little makeshifts, in that ingenious way which is commonly denominated
“by hook and by crook, ” the worthy pedagogue got on tolerably enough,
and was thought, by all who understood nothing
of the labor of headwork,
to have a wonderfully easy life of it.

text: The schoolmaster is generally a man of some importance in the female circle of a rural neighborhood; being considered a kind of idle, gentlemanlike personage, of vastly superior taste and accomplishments to the rough country swains, and, indeed, inferior in learning only to the parson.
chunks: The schoolmaster is generally a man of some importance in the female circle
of a rural neighborhood; being considered a kind
of idle, gentlemanlike personage, of vastly superior taste and accomplishments
to the rough country swains, and, indeed,
inferior in learning only to the parson.

text: His appearance, therefore, is apt to occasion some little stir at the tea-table of a farmhouse, and the addition of a supernumerary dish of cakes or sweetmeats, or, peradventure, the parade of a silver teapot.
zh: 因此，他的出现很容易在农舍的茶桌上引起一些小小的骚动，并增加一盘额外的蛋糕或甜食，或者，也许，银茶壶的游行。
chunks: His appearance, therefore, is apt to occasion some little stir
at the tea-table of a farmhouse, and the addition
of a supernumerary dish of cakes
or sweetmeats, or, peradventure, the parade
of a silver teapot.

text: Our man of letters, therefore, was peculiarly happy in the smiles of all the country damsels.
zh: 因此，我们的文人在所有乡村姑娘的微笑中感到特别高兴。
chunks: Our man
of letters, therefore,
was peculiarly happy
in the smiles
of all the country damsels.

text: From his half-itinerant life, also, he was a kind of travelling gazette, carrying the whole budget of local gossip from house to house, so that his appearance was always greeted with satisfaction.
zh: 从他半流动的生活来看，他也像一位旅行公报，挨家挨户地报​​道着当地八卦的全部预算，因此他的出现总是受到满意的欢迎。
chunks: From his half-itinerant life, also,
he was a kind of travelling gazette,
carrying the whole budget of local gossip
from house to house,
so that his appearance was always greeted with satisfaction.

text: History of New England Witchcraft,” in which, by the way, he most firmly and potently believed.
zh: 新英格兰巫术史”，顺便说一句，他最坚定、最有力地相信这一点。
chunks: History of New England Witchcraft,
” in which,
by the way,
he most firmly
and potently believed.

text: He was, in fact, an odd mixture of small shrewdness and simple credulity.
zh: 事实上，他是一个奇怪的人，既有点精明又容易轻信。
chunks: He was,
in fact,
an odd mixture
of small shrewdness
and simple credulity.

text: His appetite for the marvellous, and his powers of digesting it, were equally extraordinary; and both had been increased by his residence in this spell-bound region.
zh: 他对奇妙事物的胃口和消化能力同样非凡。由于他居住在这个令人着迷的地区，两者都得到了增加。
chunks: His appetite for the marvellous,
and his powers of digesting it,
were equally extraordinary;
and both had been increased
by his residence in this spell-bound region.

text: No tale was too gross or monstrous for his capacious swallow.
zh: 对于他那宽大的吞咽能力来说，没有什么故事是太粗俗或太可怕的。
chunks: No tale was too gross
or monstrous for his capacious swallow.

text: It was often his delight, after his school was dismissed in the afternoon, to stretch himself on the rich bed of clover bordering the little brook that whimpered by his schoolhouse, and there con over old Mather’s direful tales, until the gathering dusk of evening made the printed page a mere mist before his eyes.
chunks: It was often his delight, after his school was dismissed
in the afternoon, to stretch himself on the rich bed
of clover bordering the little brook that whimpered by his schoolhouse, and there con
over old Mather’s direful tales, until the gathering dusk
of evening made the printed page a mere mist before his eyes.

text: Hollow, as they sat by their doors of an evening, were often filled with awe at hearing his nasal melody, “in linked sweetness long drawn out,” floating from the distant hill, or along the dusky road.
zh: 晚上，当他们坐在家门口时，霍洛常常对他的鼻音旋律充满敬畏，“在绵长的连绵甜蜜中”，从远处的山上或沿着昏暗的道路飘来。
chunks: Hollow, as they sat by their doors of an evening,
were often filled with awe at hearing his nasal melody,
“in linked sweetness long drawn out,
” floating from the distant hill,
or along the dusky road.

text: Hollow, as they sometimes called him.
zh: 空洞的，人们有时这样称呼他。
chunks: Hollow,
as they sometimes called him.

text: Connecticut; and would frighten them woefully with speculations upon comets and shooting stars; and with the alarming fact that the world did absolutely turn round, and that they were half the time topsy-turvy!
zh: 康涅狄格州；并会用对彗星和流星的猜测来吓坏他们；令人震惊的事实是，世界确实发生了翻天覆地的变化，而他们有一半的时间是颠倒的！
